# Gevurah — Architecture and File Boundaries

The Awtsmoos gives no independent power to any module or line;
Awtsmoos.com becomes stronger when each vessel guards one contract by design.

## Immediate correction tranche

- Split `SocialExperienceInstaller.js` into installer facade, stylesheet registry, and ambient lifecycle coordinator.
- Keep `installSocialExperience`, `STYLE_SHEETS`, `RELEASE`, `resolveDocument`, `ensureStyle`, and `startAmbient` externally available through compatibility exports.
- Keep every rewritten executable source file under 120 lines where possible.
- Preserve `.awtsmoosSocialExperience` as the single shared-style ownership root.

## Shared-social hardening tranche

Inspect and, if touched, fully rewrite:
- `ui/IdentityMiniSheet.js`
- `ui/SocialGestureAdapter.js`
- `ui/UniversalAddSheet.js`
- their call sites and tests

Potential extra vessels:
- `ui/SheetDialogFactory.js`
- `ui/SheetFocusLifecycle.js`
- `gestures/GevurahSwipePolicy.js`
- `gestures/ChaiGestureSession.js`

## Native Social Hub tranche

After shared primitives verify:
- create native capability catalog with only real `RouteModel` destinations
- add capability-center controller/view/plugin modules
- import capability-center CSS through existing Social Hub style manifest
- mount through `HubApp` or assembly lifecycle only after exact call-site tracing

## Reader tranche

Trace exact template/import graph before editing:
- extract inline critical CSS
- split global-menu state/view/controller
- split unread-mail indicator
- preserve existing IDs and `awtsmoosAliasChange`

## Heichelos/profile/aliases tranche

Trace data normalizers, ranking, card renderers, and identity context before changing UI. Prefer source-backed quality signaling over cosmetic reordering.
